title: populus tremula subsp. grandidentata
intro: Populus tremula subsp. grandidentata, commonly known as Quaking Aspen, is a subspecies of Populus tremula, a deciduous tree native to North America. The health benefits of Quaking Aspen include its antiviral and antibacterial properties, which can help to boost the immune system and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of Quaking Aspen, such as salicin and polyphenols, contribute to its therapeutic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
